channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Online bingo addicted woman stole £30k from brother’s garage
item.description: Deborah Carman admitted fiddling the books while working at Woodrow Garage in Cawston.

item.title: WATCH: Moment F-15 avoids near collision with helicopter searching for drones
item.description: This is the extraordinary moment an F-15 fighter jet almost crashed with a police helicopter above RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk.

item.title: City centre's first indoor golf simulators a step closer
item.description: Plans for Norwich's first indoor golf simulators in Queen Street have been given the green light by City Hall.

item.title: Fears construction could worsen traffic in plans for nine homes
item.description: Proposals to build nine homes on land off Voyager Road on the city's outskirts have been met with concerns over construction traffic.

item.title: Port agrees landmark deal with major energy firm that will 'put the town on the map'
item.description: Lowestoft port operator Associated British Ports (ABP) has agreed a new partnership with Scottish Power Renewables (SPR) to support its East Anglia offshore wind farms.

item.title: Bikers killed after stolen motorcycle crashed in head-on collision on A47
item.description: Two men were killed after crashing head on into a car while riding a stolen motorbike on one of Norfolk’s most notorious roads near Great Yarmouth.

item.title: Man accused of music festival drug dealing fails to appear in court for THIRD time
item.description: Michael Adesina is charged with a string of drug offences linked to Sundown pop and urban music festival at Norfolk Showground.

item.title: Former piano shop transformed into private dining and gallery venue
item.description: Rob Howe, owner of the Bicycle Shop, an alternative café in the Norwich Lanes, has opened a new gallery space in the former Cookes Pianos shop.

item.title: Up to 19 new homes could be built on vacant Norfolk town land as plans submitted
item.description: Plans to build up to 19 new homes on land in a Dereham suburb have been lodged.

item.title: Fresh bid to restore shopfronts on historic high street
item.description: Improvements could be made to shopfronts on a historic high street in a Suffolk town provided plans get the go-ahead.
